status.description: Normalisation verdict. needs_clarification when a material ambiguity could change the contract; unsupported when the input is not an engineering selection, reuse or resolution request.

capability.description: Short normalised engineering capability in plain words. Empty only when no capability is identifiable.

summary.description: One or two sentences restating what the user asked for. Empty only when status is unsupported.

requested_artifact_level.description: The artefact level the user's own words imply. It is not a recommendation or a resolver verdict.

requirements.description: Ordered, independently inspectable behavioural claims. Empty when status is unsupported.

description.description: One independently inspectable claim, stated concretely.

required.description: True for obligations the request states; false for preferences.

constraints.description: Explicit project or user limits that the request actually states.

description.description: The limit in the user's terms.

required.description: True for hard limits; false for stated preferences.

ambiguities.description: Material open questions whose answers could substantially change the contract. Empty for ready and unsupported.

question.description: A specific question the user must answer.

why_it_matters.description: Why the answer materially changes the contract or the solution search.

assumptions.description: Small, reversible interpretation choices only. Material uncertainty belongs in ambiguities.

unsupported_reason.description: Required only when status is unsupported; otherwise empty.
